frozen.instance.yaml:
format: cortex.instance/1
name: example
description: Developments in open-source vector databases and the companies behind them.
ekr:
  version: "0.0.32"
seed:
  schema: seed/schema.yaml
  documents: []
model:
  model: claude-sonnet-5-5
  budget_usd: "1"
  timeout_s: 900
sources:
  - name: news
    schedule: "*-*-* 06:00:00"
    settings:
      kind: web
      value:
        connection: conn_replace_with_your_tavily_connection_id
        input:
          input: search
          value:
            queries:
              - open-source vector database release
              - vector database funding round
            policy:
              topic: news
              time_range: week
              max_results: 5
              include_domains: []
              exclude_domains: []
    policy:
      refresh_after_days: 30
      change: ContentHash
      max_documents_per_run: 20
      max_chars_per_document: 20000
  - name: project-docs
    schedule: "*-*-* 07:00:00"
    settings:
      kind: web
      value:
        connection: conn_replace_with_your_tavily_connection_id
        input:
          input: sites
          value:
            urls:
              - https://example.org/docs
            mode: Crawl
            policy:
              max_depth: 1
              max_breadth: 20
              limit: 10
              select_paths: ["/docs/.*"]
              exclude_paths: []
              allow_external: false
    policy:
      refresh_after_days: 7
      change: ContentHash
      max_documents_per_run: 10
      max_chars_per_document: 20000
serve: {}
frozen.seed/schema.yaml:
format: ekr.extraction-document/1
ontology:
  node_types:
  - name: Organization
    parents: []
    abstract_type: false
    properties:
    - name: website
      value: {value_kind: String}
      cardinality: One
      required: false
  - name: Product
    parents: []
    abstract_type: false
    properties: []
  edge_types:
  - name: DEVELOPS
    source_types: [Organization]
    target_types: [Product]
    cardinality: Many
    properties: []
entities: []
facts: []
evidence: []

instances.description: Developments in open-source vector databases and the companies behind them.
instances.name: example
